title: PF1 Summons
description: Summoning for Pathfinder 1e, configured from item and action sheets: fixed summons (spiritual weapon, a bonded mount, figurines) and list summons (summon monster, summon nature's ally) with tiers, quantity rolls, templates, feat augments, placement and lifecycle, with no macros needed.

recommends.reason: Placement crosshair and summon/dismiss animations. Without it, a built-in placement aid is used and nothing is animated.
Lets the summon menu open before a spell or ability is used, so cancelling it cancels the use. Without it, the menu opens afterwards and cancelling only cancels the summon.
Animation files for Sequencer. The Patreon edition works the same.
